The campus budget risk calculation succeeded with a perfect verifier reward, demonstrating a stable implementation of the weighted assessment logic.
The execution achieved a verifier_reward of 1.00 and a judge_reward of 0.92 across 1 trial with zero exceptions. Pytest 8.4.1 confirmed success in test_output.py::test_legacy_pytest_suite with a duration of 0.342s. While the logic is reusable, future iterations should re-check the sensitivity of the weighted matrix to ensure edge-case budget distributions do not skew the risk score.
